author: Edward Segal
title: Pitch your business idea for chance at loan in Mandan - NewsBreak
text: MANDAN, ND ( KXNET ) — Two Mandan organizations are collaborating to offer a $10,000 forgivable loan to assist prospective and start-up businesses. The Mandan Business Pitch Challenge, started by the Bismarck Mandan Chamber EDC and City of Mandan Business Development & Communications Department, is accepting applications for nine more days. The goal of the program is to help people fine-tune their ideas for businesses, and to give them the support they need to advance their ideas from the concept phase to launch. The North Dakota Small Business Development Center (SBDC) is also helping with the challenge. If you are eligible, you could receive a forgivable loan of up to $10,000 from the Mandan Growth Fund, along with other cash awards, services, and merchandise. The business concept that takes second place will receive $3,000, and third place will be awarded $2,000. Entries are due by August 22 and must be received by the City of Mandan Business Development & Communications Department by 4 p.m. that day. Entries may be delivered or mailed to 205 Second Avenue NW, Mandan, ND 58554, or e-mailed to bizdev@cityofmandan.com . A selection committee will choose four finalists from all the submissions. Applicants will be notified of their status by September 12. The four finalists will then be required to meet with an SBDC coach to work on revised applications and executive summaries, which they must submit by October 8. A week later, finalists will pitch their final business plans. These presentations will be open to the public, and will take place October 15 at 5:30 p.m. Finalists will have 5-7 minutes to present their business plans, after which the judges will have 10 minutes to ask them questions about it. Finalists will receive their evaluations within 48 hours of then. To learn about eligibility requirements, presentation guidelines, and more, head over to the City of Mandan website .
